name: Iron Crescent
look: a sleek robot Cresselia: a sparkling lilac pod with a pale blue glass dome, a long banded swan neck, a dark visor under a tall cream crescent, three slotted orbit rings and a glowing hover ring
entry: A Pokémon resembling Cresselia, recorded in a report about a satellite that circled a snowy summit at midnight. Its orbiting rings hum a tune that brings peaceful sleep.
how: Wild: very rare at midnight on snowy slopes and jagged peaks.
